description: Canonical gas figures of the final block-scoped ParticipationAwareHook (block scope V1 with per-transaction clipping, relative buffer, current transaction in transient storage, buffer on each transaction's net token1 change (P-net), gasPriceToken0Wad = 1e18). Overheads are gas with the hook minus the identical swap without a hook, each measured swap a cold transaction (forge test --isolate). An uncharged correction is priced at the first swap of a block whose block surplus changes (new_block_positive_surplus); when the surplus stays 0 the hook costs 35,725 instead. Additional transaction = intrinsic 21,000 + steady-state swap without a hook + hook overhead. Read by experiments/e2_blockgas.py and experiments/eB_cross_block_split.py (and through eB by eQ3, eQ4 and eQ5); GAS_BLOCK_SCOPE_CONFIG overrides the path, e.g. to reproduce a result made with an earlier version of this file.

source.explanation: NOTES/2026-10-06_block_scoped_hook.md sections 9 and 10; claude/pnet-contract dd14eaa NOTES section 4

swap_basis: cold single-range swap on a pool in steady state (Foundry test pool, measured inside the transaction)
usd_per_gas_source: P50 of C_gas_actual_usd in results/e7/tables/e7_smin_gas_conditions.csv / g_hat 180,214 (results/e7/smin_formula.txt): g_hat gas at each block's actual gas price and ETH price over all blocks of the study window
